meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides RT ad slots, sponsored lists and app prompts; blur or hide scores and posters; hide trending bar, editorial rows
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, rottentomatoes.com home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts were then switched off to evaluate): ad containers 20, mobile app call-to-action 1, sponsor header/group 8, score elements 686, poster/thumbnail images 169, trending bar 1, editorial/trailer/guide blocks 10, footer 1.

The page is built from custom elements with stable `slot`, `data-qa` and readable class names (no hashed classes). Scores and posters are Show/Blur/Hide choices so you can avoid spoilers or artwork; Hide removes the score text and icons but not the review link beneath a poster. Original cookie, ad and app-banner rules are unchanged except that the ad option gained the RT-specific `ad-inject` slots and the app option gained the mobile app strip.

NOT verified: desktop home, movie/TV/critic pages, search, the network dropped before a second pass; the cookie banner (none was shown to this session); anything signed in. Selectors do not depend on English text.
